description: Injected-error test set.  Each case is a full variant of a clean fixture with exactly one error injected; the checker must report the listed error classes for that variant.

cases.injected_error: delete a door (d1 removed from the model)
scale a wall x2 (wall w3 doubled in length)
swap a schedule symbol (t_window_01 given the symbol of t_door_01)
unclose a zone loop (wall w4 shifted 0.5 m)
door with no host wall (d1 points at a non-existent wall)
duplicate schedule tag (t_door_01 defined twice)
dangling schedule reference (zone z_unit_a cites an undefined tag)
overlapping windows on one wall (winA2 overlaps winA on ha3)
window longer than its host wall (winL 7.0 m on a 6.0 m wall)
window-to-wall ratio above the plausible band
malformed fixture: non-numeric coordinate
malformed fixture: opening without a host wall reference
silently delete the door: d1 removed from the geometry AND from the zone opening list, while the schedule still lists 1 door
silently delete a window: win2 removed from the geometry AND from the zone opening list, while the schedule still lists 2 windows
schedule quantity disagrees with the geometry (t_window_01 declares 3 windows, geometry carries 2)
zone opening list disagrees with its schedule mark (t_zone_office declares 4 openings, zone lists 3)
schedule symbol count mismatch: winB re-tagged from t_window_02 to t_window_01, so both window marks disagree with the geometry
door re-classified as a window (dB kind door -> window) while the schedule still counts 2 doors
zone reference dropped only: dB stays in the geometry but is removed from the zone opening list
silently delete the corridor window: winC removed from the geometry AND from the zone opening list, while the schedule still lists 1 window
an extra window is added to the geometry and to the zone list (schedule quantity no longer matches)
unclose a zone loop in a larger building (wall r6 shortened by 0.5 m)
duplicate schedule symbol in a larger building (t_window_03 given symbol W01)
malformed fixture: schedule quantity is not a positive integer (count = -1)

the internal door on the shared wall c3 (classroom/corridor) is listed in no zone at all -- every zone reference dropped and the zone quantity mark regenerated to match, so the model is self-consistent
the internal door on the shared wall p7 (living/kitchen) is additionally listed in the bathroom, which does not border p7 -- a wrong zone assignment
the unit A entrance door dA (single-owner wall ha1) is additionally listed in unit B, which does not border ha1 -- a wrong zone assignment on a single-owner wall
